model.api: Meta Model API, Responses API, https://api.meta.ai/v1

production_effort: minimal (receipts/extract.py EFFORT; unchanged by this run)

method.grading: eval/bench_models.py: load_gold, match_gold (+_assign), _text_match, raw_report, verdicts, call_latencies
method.extraction: receipts.extract.extract_detailed: per-passage Responses calls, strict text.format schema, call_with_retry (429/500/502/503), 120 s per attempt, max_output_tokens 8000
method.cache: a new, empty response-cache directory per level, outside data/: 30/30 calls were live (0 cache hits)
method.requests: minimal is byte-identical to the production request; low and medium differ only in reasoning.effort (checked by request hash for all 30 calls)
method.order: minimal, then low, then medium, within 65 s; each level's 10 passages in parallel, except medium (see waves)
method.why_not_the_cli: eval/bench_models.py main() writes data/bench/ and data/cache/bench/ and rebuilds eval/bench_results.md, and its 'spark' target ignores RECEIPTS_EXTRACT_EFFORT; the driver calls the harness's grading functions instead

denominators.note: code expands a claim stated for both GAAP and non-GAAP into two claims, so 23 raw claims become 28 shipped claims

low.wall_note: one parallel wave of 10 calls (the product's pattern)

medium.wall_note: 2 sequential waves to keep the hard budget cap; use call_latency_max_s as the parallel wall-time proxy (bench_models does the same for mixed runs)

disagreement_review.scope: every field of every raw model claim, aligned by value_text across the three live levels; JSON number formatting (18 vs 18.0) is normalized away
reading: metric_text and span_text differ in display wording and quote boundaries only. Canonical metric, value, unit, scale, bases, comparison, entity and segment never differed, and every span stayed verbatim and contained its value.

period_text on 4 raw claims (5 gold claims, because 75.0% is stated for both bases): minimal copied 'For the quarter' (75.0%, $2.46, $2.22) or 'the end of the second quarter' ($99.0 billion) where low or medium wrote 'second quarter ended July 26, 2026' or 'As of the end of the second quarter'. Both resolve to the same fiscal period, and all pass the grader's period check.

period_text on the $500 billion third-party-capital claim: medium wrote 'over time', minimal and low the quarter. The gold label has no period, the metric is 'other' and the claim is forward-looking, so it is ? at every level.
period_type of the $0.25 dividend: minimal 'unknown', low and medium 'quarter'. The verdict is unaffected (forward-looking, ?).

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Re-verify the sweep's claims with committed code (a git archive of one commit), offline.

Claims are replayed from each level's own response cache (no network); verdicts come from the archived
receipts.verify and receipts.store over the archived evidence. Prints a comparison with the live record.

    python -I reverify.py CLEAN_TREE LIVE_JSON EVIDENCE_DIR
"""
import importlib.util, json, sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
tree, live_path, evidence = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3])
sys.path.insert(0, str(tree))
from receipts import extract as ex
from receipts.store import Store
import receipts.verify as verify_mod
assert Path(verify_mod.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(tree.resolve()), verify_mod.__file__
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bench_clean", tree / "eval" / "bench_models.py")
bm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules[spec.name] = bm; spec.loader.exec_module(bm)

class CacheOnly:
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        raise ex.ExtractionError("replay: missing cached response; nothing sent")

live = json.loads(live_path.read_text())
store = Store(db_path=evidence / "facts.sqlite", pr_dir=evidence / "data" / "snapshot" / "pr_facts")
text = (tree / "spikes/inputs/gold_text.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
out = {}
for level, m in live["levels"].items():
    b = ex.resolve_backend({"RECEIPTS_EXTRACT_EFFORT": level})
    res = ex.extract_detailed(text, None, client=CacheOnly(), cache_dir=Path(m["cache_dir"]), backend=b)
    vs = bm.verdicts(res.claims, store, None, res.context)
    clean = Counter((c.value_text, c.metric, c.basis, v.status, v.reason) for c, v in zip(res.claims, vs))
    run = Counter((r["value_text"], r["metric"], r["basis"], r["verdict"], r["reason"]) for r in m["shipped"])
    out[level] = {"claims": len(res.claims), "cached_calls": res.cached_calls,
                  "verdicts_clean": dict(Counter(v.status for v in vs)), "identical_to_run": clean == run,
                  "only_in_clean": [list(k) for k in (clean - run)], "only_in_run": [list(k) for k in (run - clean)]}
print(json.dumps({"verify_module": str(verify_mod.__file__), "levels": out}, indent=1))

offline_reproduction_of_the_eval/bench_r.input: the 10 cached 2026-10-29 minimal gold responses (data/cache/bench, read only), scored by the same driver with no network client
offline_reproduction_of_the_eval/bench_r.published_row: 27/27 strict recall and precision, 0/23 raw wrong, 23/23 verbatim, 0 label errors, 0 unflagged, 7.9 s recorded max, $0.041

limitations: One live run per level on one document: 10 passages of one NVIDIA press release, 27 claims. This is not a general accuracy claim and gives no variance estimate.

Ceiling effect: minimal already scores 27/27 here, so this set cannot show a gain from more reasoning. Tables, multi-company roundups, qualifiers and long passages may behave differently; the dev, trap and held-out sets were not run.
Same-effort sampling variation is at least one claim on this set (run_to_run_variation_at_the_same_effort).
The gold labels are provisional and still await human review (eval/bench_results.md).
Medium ran in two waves (6 + 4) to keep the hard budget cap, so its wall time is a proxy: the slowest call, 21.4 s. Minimal and low ran as one parallel wave, as the product does.
Latency is one sample per call and depends on server load at 2026-10-30 19:45 UTC.
Verdicts use the committed data/snapshot at the recorded commit, not the larger local evidence store that another agent is building.
Only claim extraction was tested; Slide vision, Ask planning, whole-filing quotes and Fix keep their own effort settings.

driver.source:
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Reasoning-effort sweep for NoCap claim extraction (muse-spark-1.3 on Meta Model API, Standard ID).

Drives eval/bench_models.py's own gold grading (load_gold, match_gold, _assign, _text_match, raw_report,
verdicts, call_latencies) on the 27-claim NVIDIA gold set at reasoning efforts minimal, low and medium.

* Backend: the code's existing override, receipts.extract.resolve_backend({"RECEIPTS_EXTRACT_EFFORT": level}).
  No repository code is edited, and .env is never read by this script (the SDK client setup in
  receipts.extract.make_client loads MODEL_API_KEY itself).
* Extraction: receipts.extract.extract_detailed, exactly as bench_models.run_target calls it (10 passages in
  parallel, call_with_retry, 120 s per attempt, max_output_tokens 8000, strict text.format).
* Cache: every level gets a new, empty response-cache directory outside data/, so every call is live; raw
  model JSON is read back from that directory by raw_report, as in the harness.
* Evidence for receipts.verify: the committed data/snapshot at git HEAD, extracted into --evidence-dir.
* Budget: --cap-usd is enforced before every wave from conservative per-call bounds (see plan()).

    python -I sweep.py --out JSON --scratch DIR --evidence-dir DIR [--dry-run-cache DIR]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import math
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional

ROOT = Path("<repo>")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from receipts import extract as ex  # noqa: E402
from receipts.store import Store  # noqa: E402

LEVELS = ("minimal", "low", "medium")
PRICES = ex.PRICE_PER_M
# Conservative bound for one call: an uncached 3,000-token input (measured inputs are ~2,200) plus the full
# 8,000-token output limit that reasoning and JSON share.
HARD_CALL_BOUND_USD = (3000 * PRICES["input"] + ex.MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS * PRICES["output"]) / 1e6
# Data-driven bounds that allow one parallel wave (the product's latency pattern):
#   minimal: 2x the most expensive of 441 recorded minimal calls on this prompt ($0.0087)
#   low:     4x the mean call of Spike B2's one low-effort parallel run on this gold set ($0.0708 / 10)
EMPIRICAL_CALL_BOUND_USD = {"minimal": 0.0174, "low": 0.028}
PREDICTED_LEVEL_USD = {"minimal": 0.045, "low": 0.075}   # bench 2026-10-29: $0.041; Spike B2 low: $0.0708
MEDIUM_FLOOR_USD = 0.12                                  # medium prediction floor (no prior medium data)


def load_bench() -> Any:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bench_models_for_sweep", ROOT / "eval" / "bench_models.py")
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


class Recorder:
    """Pass-through client that logs what the API echoed back (model, status, incomplete reason)."""

    def __init__(self, client: Any):
        self._client = client
        self.responses = self
        self.log: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def create(self, **kw: Any) -> Any:
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        entry: dict[str, Any] = {"effort_sent": (kw.get("reasoning") or {}).get("effort"), "model_sent": kw.get("model"),
                                 "store_sent": kw.get("store")}
        try:
            r = self._client.responses.create(**kw)
        except Exception as e:  # logged, then re-raised to the extractor's own retry policy
            entry.update(error=type(e).__name__, status_code=getattr(e, "status_code", None),
                         latency_s=round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2))
            with self._lock:
                self.log.append(entry)
            raise
        details = getattr(r, "incomplete_details", None)
        entry.update(response_id=r.id, model_echoed=getattr(r, "model", None), status=getattr(r, "status", None),
                     incomplete_reason=getattr(details, "reason", None) if details else None,
                     latency_s=round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2))
        with self._lock:
            self.log.append(entry)
        return r


class CacheOnly:
    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
        raise ex.ExtractionError("dry run: a response is missing from the cache; no request was sent")


def sha256_file(p: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def prepare_evidence(evidence_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The committed data/snapshot at HEAD, written outside data/ (another agent is editing data/)."""
    commit = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], check=True, capture_output=True,
                            text=True).stdout.strip()
    if evidence_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(evidence_dir)
    evidence_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    db = evidence_dir / "facts.sqlite"
    db.write_bytes(subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "cat-file", "blob", "HEAD:data/snapshot/facts.sqlite"],
                                  check=True, capture_output=True).stdout)
    archive = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "archive", "HEAD", "data/snapshot/pr_facts"], check=True,
                             capture_output=True).stdout
    subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(evidence_dir)], input=archive, check=True)
    pr_dir = evidence_dir / "data" / "snapshot" / "pr_facts"
    return {"source": "git HEAD:data/snapshot (facts.sqlite + pr_facts)", "commit": commit,
            "facts_sqlite_sha256": sha256_file(db), "pr_facts_files": sum(1 for _ in pr_dir.rglob("*.jsonl")),
            "db_path": str(db), "pr_dir": str(pr_dir)}


def plan(level: str, remaining_usd: float, n: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """('single', n) when one parallel wave fits the remaining budget under a data-driven bound, otherwise
    ('waves', k): at most k calls in flight, each charged the hard bound, so the cap cannot be passed."""
    bound = EMPIRICAL_CALL_BOUND_USD.get(level)
    if bound is not None and n * bound <= remaining_usd:
        return "single", n
    return "waves", int(remaining_usd // HARD_CALL_BOUND_USD)


def strict_and_value_pairs(bm: Any, entries: list[dict[str, Any]], gold: list[dict[str, Any]]):
    """bench_models.match_gold's matching, returning the assigned (gold, entry) pairs instead of entry sets."""
    strict_pairs, value_pairs = [], []
    for gi, g in enumerate(gold):
        target = g["value"] * bm.SCALE[g["scale"]]
        for ei, e in enumerate(entries):
            if not math.isclose(e["value"] * bm.SCALE.get(e["scale"], 1.0), target, rel_tol=1e-6, abs_tol=1e-9):
                continue
            value_pairs.append((gi, ei))
            if (e["metric"] in g["canonical"] and (g["basis"] is None or e["basis"] == g["basis"])
                    and (not g["period"] or bm._text_match(e["period_text"], g["period"]))):
                strict_pairs.append((gi, ei))
    return bm._assign(strict_pairs), bm._assign(value_pairs)


def claim_row(c: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {k: getattr(c, k) for k in ("metric", "metric_text", "value_text", "value", "unit", "scale", "period_text",
                                       "period_type", "comparison", "basis", "forward_looking", "entity", "segment",
                                       "span_text")}


def run_level(level: str, *, bm: Any, gold_text: str, ctx: str, gold: list[dict[str, Any]], store: Any,
              cache_root: Path, budget: dict[str, float], dry_run_cache: Optional[Path]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    b = ex.resolve_backend({"RECEIPTS_EXTRACT_EFFORT": level})
    passages = [p for _, p in ex.split_passages(gold_text)]
    expected_keys = {ex.request_key(ex.build_request(p, ctx, backend=b), b): i for i, p in enumerate(passages)}
    out: dict[str, Any] = {"effort": level, "backend": b.name, "model_requested": b.model, "base_url": b.base_url,
                           "backend_effort_override": b.effort, "max_output_tokens": ex.MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS}
    if dry_run_cache is not None:
        cache_dir = dry_run_cache
        client: Any = CacheOnly()
        recorder = None
    else:
        cache_dir = cache_root / f"{level}-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"
        cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)   # new and empty: no response can be a cache hit
        recorder = Recorder(ex.make_client(backend=b))
        client = recorder
    out["cache_dir"] = str(cache_dir)

    remaining = budget["cap"] - budget["spent"]
    mode, k = plan(level, remaining, len(passages)) if dry_run_cache is None else ("single", len(passages))
    out["admission"] = {"mode": mode, "max_in_flight": k, "remaining_before_usd": round(remaining, 6),
                        "hard_call_bound_usd": round(HARD_CALL_BOUND_USD, 6),
                        "empirical_call_bound_usd": EMPIRICAL_CALL_BOUND_USD.get(level)}
    waves: list[tuple[str, Any, Optional[str]]] = []   # (wave text, ExtractResult, context argument)
    skipped: list[int] = []
    if mode == "single":
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        res = ex.extract_detailed(gold_text, None, client=client, cache_dir=cache_dir, backend=b)  # as the harness
        budget["spent"] += res.cost_usd
        waves.append((gold_text, res, None))
        out["wall_s"] = res.wall_s
        out["wall_from"] = "one parallel wave of 10 calls (the product's pattern)"
        out["wall_outer_s"] = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2)
    else:
        todo = list(range(len(passages)))
        while todo:
            k = int((budget["cap"] - budget["spent"]) // HARD_CALL_BOUND_USD)
            if k <= 0:
                skipped = todo
                break
            wave, todo = todo[:k], todo[k:]
            text = "\n\n".join(passages[i] for i in wave)
            res = ex.extract_detailed(text, ctx, client=client, cache_dir=cache_dir, backend=b, concurrency=len(wave))
            budget["spent"] += res.cost_usd
            waves.append((text, res, ctx))
        out["wall_s"] = None
        out["wall_from"] = (f"{len(waves)} sequential waves to keep the hard budget cap; use call_latency_max_s as "
                            "the parallel wall-time proxy (bench_models does the same for mixed runs)")
    out["waves"] = [len(r.calls) for _, r, _ in waves]
    out["skipped_passages"] = skipped

    # ---- merge waves and grade with the harness's own functions ----
    claims: list[Any] = []
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    uncovered: list[str] = []
    raw_tot: Counter = Counter()
    raw_reasons: Counter = Counter()
    raw_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    raw_examples: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    latencies: list[float] = []
    claim_passage: list[int] = []
    for text, res, _ in waves:
        offsets = ex.split_passages(text)
        for c in res.claims:
            start = next(s for s, p in offsets if s <= c.span_start < s + len(p))
            claim_passage.append(passages.index(dict(offsets)[start]))
            claims.append(c)
        for call in res.calls:
            call = dict(call)
            call["gold_passage"] = expected_keys.get(call["request_sha256"])
            calls.append(call)
        uncovered.extend(t["text"] for t in res.uncovered)
        raw = bm.raw_report(res, text, b, cache_dir)
        raw_tot.update({k: raw[k] for k in ("claims", "wrong", "verbatim_spans", "schema_rejected", "failed_calls")})
        raw_reasons.update(raw["by_reason"])
        raw_entries.extend(raw["entries"])
        raw_examples.extend(raw["examples"])
        latencies.extend(bm.call_latencies(res, cache_dir))
    sent_ok = all(c["gold_passage"] is not None for c in calls)
    out["requests_match_intended_effort"] = sent_ok and len({c["gold_passage"] for c in calls}) == len(calls)

    entries = [{"metric": c.metric, "value": c.value, "scale": c.scale, "basis": c.basis,
                "period_text": c.period_text} for c in claims]
    strict_set, value_set = bm.match_gold(entries, gold)
    raw_strict, raw_value = bm.match_gold(raw_entries, gold)
    strict_pairs, value_pairs = strict_and_value_pairs(bm, entries, gold)
    assert {e for _, e in strict_pairs} == strict_set and {e for _, e in value_pairs} == value_set
    vs = bm.verdicts(claims, store, None, ctx)
    unmatched = [i for i in range(len(claims)) if i not in strict_set]

    def field_ok(gi: int, ei: int) -> dict[str, bool]:
        g, e = gold[gi], entries[ei]
        return {"metric": e["metric"] in g["canonical"], "basis": g["basis"] is None or e["basis"] == g["basis"],
                "period": (not g["period"]) or bm._text_match(e["period_text"], g["period"])}

    # Field alignment: strict pairs first (all fields agree), then each remaining gold claim takes the unused
    # value-matched entry that agrees on the most fields. A value-only assignment can cross-pair claims that
    # share a value (GAAP and non-GAAP "both 75.0%"), which would understate field agreement.
    aligned = dict(strict_pairs)
    used = set(aligned.values())
    candidates = []
    for gi, g in enumerate(gold):
        if gi in aligned:
            continue
        target = g["value"] * bm.SCALE[g["scale"]]
        for ei, e in enumerate(entries):
            if ei not in used and math.isclose(e["value"] * bm.SCALE.get(e["scale"], 1.0), target,
                                               rel_tol=1e-6, abs_tol=1e-9):
                candidates.append((-sum(field_ok(gi, ei).values()), gi, ei))
    for _, gi, ei in sorted(candidates):
        if gi not in aligned and ei not in used:
            aligned[gi] = ei
            used.add(ei)
    fields = Counter()
    for gi, ei in aligned.items():
        ok = field_ok(gi, ei)
        fields["value"] += 1
        fields.update(k for k, v in ok.items() if v)
        fields["all_three_labels"] += all(ok.values())

    usage = [c.get("usage") for c in calls if c.get("usage")]
    tokens = {k: sum((u or {}).get(k, 0) for u in usage)
              for k in ("input_tokens", "cached_tokens", "output_tokens", "reasoning_tokens")}
    per_call = sorted(({"gold_passage": c["gold_passage"], "status": c.get("status"), "attempts": c.get("attempts"),
                        "cached": c.get("cached"), "latency_s": c.get("latency_s"),
                        "response_status": c.get("response_status"), "usage": c.get("usage"),
                        "cost_usd": c.get("cost_usd"), "problem": c.get("problem"),
                        "error": (c.get("error") or {}).get("kind")} for c in calls),
                      key=lambda r: (r["gold_passage"] is None, r["gold_passage"]))
    strict_by_gold = {gi: ei for gi, ei in strict_pairs}
    per_gold = []
    for gi, g in enumerate(gold):
        ei = aligned.get(gi)
        per_gold.append({"gold": gi, "value_text": g["value_text"], "label": g["labels"][0],
                         "match": "strict" if gi in strict_by_gold else "value_only" if gi in aligned else "missing",
                         "fields_ok": field_ok(gi, ei) if ei is not None else None,
                         "claim": claim_row(claims[ei]) if ei is not None else None,
                         "verdict": vs[ei].status if ei is not None else None,
                         "reason": vs[ei].reason if ei is not None else None})
    out.update({
        "passages": len(passages), "calls": len(calls),
        "failed_passages": sum(c.get("status") != "ok" for c in calls),
        "fresh_calls": sum(not c.get("cached") for c in calls),
        "context": ctx,
        "raw": {**{k: raw_tot[k] for k in ("claims", "wrong", "verbatim_spans", "schema_rejected", "failed_calls")},
                "by_reason": dict(raw_reasons), "examples": raw_examples[:10]},
        "raw_label_errors": max(0, len(raw_value) - len(raw_strict)),
        "shipped_claims": len(claims), "strict_matched": len(strict_set), "value_matched": len(value_set),
        "recall": len(strict_set) / len(gold), "precision": (len(strict_set) / len(claims)) if claims else None,
        "field_matches_over_value_matched": dict(fields),
        "verdicts": dict(Counter(v.status for v in vs)),
        "unmatched": [{"value_text": claims[i].value_text, "metric": claims[i].metric, "basis": claims[i].basis,
                       "period_text": claims[i].period_text, "verdict": vs[i].status, "reason": vs[i].reason}
                      for i in unmatched],
        "unflagged_errors": sum(vs[i].status == "verified" for i in unmatched),
        "uncovered_numbers": uncovered,
        "call_latency_p50_s": round(statistics.median(latencies), 2) if latencies else None,
        "call_latency_max_s": round(max(latencies), 2) if latencies else None,
        "tokens": tokens,
        "cost_per_check_usd": round(sum(ex.cost_usd(u, b.prices) for u in usage), 6),
        "spent_usd": round(sum(r.cost_usd for _, r, _ in waves), 6),
        "cost_is_estimate": any(c.get("cost_is_estimate") for c in calls),
        "per_call": per_call,
        "per_gold": per_gold,
        "shipped": [{**claim_row(c), "gold_passage": claim_passage[i], "verdict": vs[i].status, "reason": vs[i].reason}
                    for i, c in enumerate(claims)],
        "api_echo": recorder.log if recorder else [],
    })
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--scratch", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--evidence-dir", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cap-usd", type=float, default=0.35)
    ap.add_argument("--levels", default=",".join(LEVELS))
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run-cache", type=Path, help="score cached minimal responses only; no network")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    for forbidden in (args.out, args.scratch, args.evidence_dir):
        if (ROOT / "data") in forbidden.resolve().parents or forbidden.resolve() == ROOT / "data":
            raise SystemExit(f"refusing to write under data/: {forbidden}")
    free = shutil.disk_usage("/System/Volumes/Data").free
    if free < 700 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise SystemExit(f"stopping: only {free / 2**20:.0f} MB free on /System/Volumes/Data")

    bm = load_bench()
    gold = bm.load_gold()
    assert len(gold) == 27, len(gold)
    gold_text = bm.GOLD_TEXT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ctx = ex.infer_context(gold_text)
    evidence = prepare_evidence(args.evidence_dir)
    store = Store(db_path=Path(evidence["db_path"]), pr_dir=Path(evidence["pr_dir"]))
    budget = {"cap": args.cap_usd, "spent": 0.0}
    levels = [lv for lv in args.levels.split(",") if lv]
    if args.dry_run_cache:
        levels = ["minimal"]
    record: dict[str, Any] = {
        "experiment": "reasoning-effort sweep for claim extraction",
        "started_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "dry_run": bool(args.dry_run_cache),
        "model": "muse-spark-1.3", "api": "Meta Model API, Responses API, https://api.meta.ai/v1",
        "mode": "Standard (no -contributor ID)",
        "harness": {"grading": "eval/bench_models.py: load_gold, match_gold (+_assign), _text_match, raw_report, "
                               "verdicts, call_latencies",
                    "extraction": "receipts.extract.extract_detailed: per-passage Responses calls, strict text.format "
                                  "schema, call_with_retry (429/500/502/503), 120 s per attempt, max_output_tokens 8000",
                    "effort_override": "receipts.extract.resolve_backend({'RECEIPTS_EXTRACT_EFFORT': level})"},
        "gold": {"text": "spikes/inputs/gold_text.txt", "labels": "spikes/inputs/gold_claims.json", "passages": 10,
                 "claims": len(gold), "context_line": ctx},
        "evidence": {k: v for k, v in evidence.items() if k not in ("db_path", "pr_dir")},
        "budget": {"cap_usd": args.cap_usd, "hard_call_bound_usd": round(HARD_CALL_BOUND_USD, 6),
                   "empirical_call_bound_usd": EMPIRICAL_CALL_BOUND_USD, "predicted_level_usd": PREDICTED_LEVEL_USD},
        "levels": {},
    }
    for level in levels:
        if level == "medium":
            low_cost = (record["levels"].get("low") or {}).get("spent_usd") or PREDICTED_LEVEL_USD["low"]
            predicted = max(MEDIUM_FLOOR_USD, 2.2 * low_cost)
        else:
            predicted = PREDICTED_LEVEL_USD[level]
        if not args.dry_run_cache and budget["spent"] + predicted > budget["cap"]:
            record["levels"][level] = {"effort": level, "skipped": f"predicted ${predicted:.3f} would pass the cap "
                                                                    f"(spent ${budget['spent']:.4f} of ${budget['cap']:.2f})"}
            print(f"== {level}: skipped, predicted ${predicted:.3f}", flush=True)
            continue
        print(f"== {level}: predicted ${predicted:.3f}; spent so far ${budget['spent']:.4f}", flush=True)
        out = run_level(level, bm=bm, gold_text=gold_text, ctx=ctx, gold=gold, store=store,
                        cache_root=args.scratch / "cache", budget=budget, dry_run_cache=args.dry_run_cache)
        out["predicted_usd"] = round(predicted, 4)
        record["levels"][level] = out
        print(f"   recall {out['strict_matched']}/27, precision {out['strict_matched']}/{out['shipped_claims']}, "
              f"failed {out['failed_passages']}, wall {out['wall_s']}, p50 {out['call_latency_p50_s']} max "
              f"{out['call_latency_max_s']}, tokens {out['tokens']}, spent ${out['spent_usd']:.4f}; total "
              f"${budget['spent']:.4f}", flush=True)
    record["budget"]["spent_usd"] = round(budget["spent"], 6)
    record["finished_utc"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    src = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    record["driver"] = {"path": str(Path(__file__)), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(),
                        "source": src}
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {args.out}; total spent ${budget['spent']:.4f} of ${budget['cap']:.2f}", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Turn the sweep driver's raw record into eval/effort_sweep.json: summary, denominators, disagreement review,
same-effort variation, offline validation, spend and limitations. No network.

    python -I build_record.py LIVE_JSON DRYRUN_JSON DRYRUN_CACHE_DIR OUT_JSON REVERIFY_JSON
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("<repo>")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from receipts import extract as ex  # noqa: E402

L = ("minimal", "low", "medium")
FIELDS = ("metric", "metric_text", "value", "unit", "scale", "period_text", "period_type", "comparison", "bases",
          "forward_looking", "entity", "segment", "span_text")


def main() -> int:
    live = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    dry = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())
    dry_cache, out_path = Path(sys.argv[3]), Path(sys.argv[4])
    reverify = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[5]).read_text())
    reverify_src = Path(__file__).with_name("reverify.py")
    text = (ROOT / "spikes/inputs/gold_text.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ctx = ex.infer_context(text)
    passages = [p for _, p in ex.split_passages(text)]

    def raw_for(level: str, cache_dir: Path) -> dict[int, list[dict]]:
        b = ex.resolve_backend({"RECEIPTS_EXTRACT_EFFORT": level})
        res = {}
        for i, p in enumerate(passages):
            k = ex.request_key(ex.build_request(p, ctx, backend=b), b)
            res[i] = json.loads(json.loads((cache_dir / f"{k}.json").read_text())["output_text"])["claims"]
        return res

    lv = live["levels"]
    raw = {n: raw_for(n, Path(lv[n]["cache_dir"])) for n in L}
    raw_1029 = raw_for("minimal", dry_cache)

    def norm(f: str, v):
        return float(v) if f == "value" and v is not None else json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True)

    def diff_runs(runs: dict[str, dict[int, list[dict]]]):
        by_field, differing, examples, presence = Counter(), 0, [], []
        for i in range(len(passages)):
            keyed: dict = {}
            for name, r in runs.items():
                seen: dict = defaultdict(int)
                for c in r[i]:
                    key = (c["value_text"], seen[c["value_text"]])
                    seen[c["value_text"]] += 1
                    keyed.setdefault(key, {})[name] = c
            for key, per in keyed.items():
                if set(per) != set(runs):
                    presence.append({"passage": i, "value_text": key[0], "present_in": sorted(per)})
                    continue
                fields = [f for f in FIELDS if len({norm(f, per[n].get(f)) for n in runs}) > 1]
                if fields:
                    differing += 1
                    by_field.update(fields)
                    examples.extend({"passage": i, "value_text": key[0], "field": f, **{n: per[n].get(f) for n in runs}}
                                    for f in fields)
        return differing, dict(by_field), examples, presence

    n_live, f_live, ex_live, pres_live = diff_runs({n: raw[n] for n in L})
    n_1029, f_1029, ex_1029, pres_1029 = diff_runs({"minimal_2026-10-30": raw["minimal"],
                                                    "minimal_2026-10-29": raw_1029})

    base_cost, base_wall = lv["minimal"]["cost_per_check_usd"], lv["minimal"]["wall_s"]
    summary = {}
    for n in L:
        m = lv[n]
        wall = m["wall_s"] if m["wall_s"] is not None else m["call_latency_max_s"]
        same = sum(a["verdict"] == b["verdict"] and a["reason"] == b["reason"] and a["match"] == b["match"]
                   for a, b in zip(m["per_gold"], lv["minimal"]["per_gold"]))
        summary[n] = {
            "strict_recall": f"{m['strict_matched']}/27", "strict_precision": f"{m['strict_matched']}/{m['shipped_claims']}",
            "field_matches_of_27_gold": m["field_matches_over_value_matched"],
            "raw_claims_wrong_as_returned": f"{m['raw']['wrong']}/{m['raw']['claims']}",
            "verbatim_spans": f"{m['raw']['verbatim_spans']}/{m['raw']['claims']}",
            "label_errors": m["raw_label_errors"], "schema_rejected_claims": m["raw"]["schema_rejected"],
            "failed_calls": m["failed_passages"],
            "verdicts_on_shipped_claims": m["verdicts"], "unflagged_errors": m["unflagged_errors"],
            "gold_verdicts_identical_to_minimal": f"{same}/27",
            "wall_s": m["wall_s"], "wall_s_for_comparison": wall, "wall_note": m["wall_from"], "waves": m["waves"],
            "call_latency_p50_s": m["call_latency_p50_s"], "call_latency_max_s": m["call_latency_max_s"],
            "tokens": m["tokens"], "cost_usd": m["cost_per_check_usd"],
            "cost_vs_minimal": round(m["cost_per_check_usd"] / base_cost, 2),
            "wall_vs_minimal": round(wall / base_wall, 2),
            "output_tokens_vs_minimal": round(m["tokens"]["output_tokens"] / lv["minimal"]["tokens"]["output_tokens"], 2),
            "reasoning_tokens_vs_minimal": round(m["tokens"]["reasoning_tokens"]
                                                 / lv["minimal"]["tokens"]["reasoning_tokens"], 2),
        }

    shipped_same = len({json.dumps(sorted(Counter((r["value_text"], r["metric"], r["basis"], r["verdict"], r["reason"])
                                                  for r in lv[n]["shipped"]).items())) for n in L}) == 1
    gold_verdicts = {f"{v} ({r})": k for (v, r), k in
                     Counter((r["verdict"], r["reason"]) for r in lv["minimal"]["per_gold"]).most_common()}
    dry_m = dry["levels"]["minimal"]
    record = {
        "title": "Reasoning-effort sweep: Muse Spark 1.3 claim extraction on the 27-claim NVIDIA gold set",
        "run_utc": {"started": live["started_utc"], "finished": live["finished_utc"]}, "run_date_taipei": "2026-10-31",
        "model": {"requested": "muse-spark-1.3",
                  "echoed_by_api": dict(Counter(e.get("model_echoed") for n in L for e in lv[n]["api_echo"])),
                  "response_status": dict(Counter(e.get("status") for n in L for e in lv[n]["api_echo"])),
                  "mode": "Standard (no -contributor ID)", "api": live["api"]},
